g.text: Publication 2 · hottest port on each node
One-second requested cadence · shaded area is driver publication span · counters are node-wide
Each point is a delta over its actual counter interval and is plotted at interval end. Boundary points mix neighboring phases.
8 × 400 Gb/s node denominator; 400 Gb/s per-port denominator. Passive sampler command time/coverage are retained in results.json.
